subject: Emotions
title: Love at First Sight
description: A short lesson to help you apply Love at First Sight.

hook.text: A woman locks eyes with a stranger across a room and feels she's known him forever. Is love at first sight real?

buildup.text: Surveys show 60% of people claim to have experienced it. But brain research suggests something else is happening.

discovery.text: In one-fifth of a second, the brain releases euphoria chemicals for an attractive face. Speed creates the illusion.

twist.text: What feels like 'knowing' is pattern matching. Your brain compares them to a mix of every face you've found attractive.

climax.text: Love at first sight is attraction at first sight, plus a narrative you build afterward. Memory rewrites the moment.

punchline.text: It wasn't love at first sight. It was chemistry at first glance.

quiz.question: How quickly can the brain release euphoria chemicals when seeing an attractive face?
